title: FixResult
description: One fix from one method at one moment. Producers: Person 2 (drone), Person 3 (horizon, ground). Path: results/<method>/fixes/<photo_id>.json.

photo_id.description: The photo's id in its archive.

uncertainty_m.description: Uncertainty circle radius in ground metres. PROPOSED, confirm at H0: the 95% radius.

confidence_pct.description: PROPOSED, confirm at H0: the share of tested fixes, for this method and terrain type, whose true position fell inside their circle.

time_per_fix_s.description: Seconds the fix took to compute.

simulated.description: True for any result not measured on real photos. Required, no default; the app shows a label whenever it is true.

overlay.description: Repo-relative path of the overlay image that draws this fix on the base map.

truth.description: Answer-key values for a tested photo; null for a fix on the demo walk.

oneOf.title: Truth
oneOf.description: Answer-key values. Only tested photos have them.

position_error_m.description: Error in ground metres, from the shared scorer.

heading_error_deg.description: Heading error from the shared scorer; wraps at 360°, so 0 to 180.
